reels.caption:
The love of a serene coastal bedroom runs deep around here. Here's a few ways to give your bedroom space that sense of calm to help you exhale at the of your day 💨😮‍💨.
🎨 Incorporate a color palette inspired by nature. Muted neutrals and blues can automatically give a peaceful feeling to any space.
🌾 Add in organic textures with accent furniture & lighting. A few favorite places to add texture is with a bench or ottomans at the end of the bed, accent chairs, mirrors, lamps and even rugs.
🛏️ Mix up your materials to give the room a sense of balance. For a bedroom space, an upholstered bed works with natural wood nightstands and dressers to give a collected and unique look that's not too matchy matchy.
.
